name: Bachmann E-Z Track (N)
description: Bachmann E-Z Track (N) is the N-scale companion to the HO E-Z Track system: nickel-silver rail molded into integrated gray plastic roadbed sections. The N range is narrower than the HO range — Bachmann concentrates on a small number of straight lengths, two curve radii (11.25" and 11.4"), and a basic left/right turnout pair. SKUs are 5-digit Bachmann part numbers. Unlike HO, the N E-Z Track line is offered only in nickel silver (no steel-rail variant in current production).

pieces.label: 5" straight
pieces.notes: 5 in × 25.4 = 127.0 mm. The standard N E-Z Track straight; analogous to HO's 9" straight. SKU not asserted here — Bachmann's HO and N catalogues share number ranges and dealer listings show inconsistent N straight SKUs across editions, so left null per the schema's ‘empty is honest’ rule.

pieces.label: 2.5" straight
pieces.notes: Half-section fitter. 2.5 in × 25.4 = 63.5 mm. SKU varies between catalogues — left null pending verification.

pieces.label: 1.25" straight
pieces.notes: Quarter-section short fitter. 1.25 in × 25.4 = 31.75 mm. SKU not asserted.

pieces.label: 11.25" radius curve, 22.5°
pieces.notes: 16 sections form a full 360° circle. radius 11.25 in × 25.4 = 285.75 mm; arc length = 2π × 285.75 × (22.5 / 360) = 112.205 mm. Standard sectional N curve.

pieces.label: 11.4" radius curve, 22.5°
pieces.notes: Slightly larger N-scale radius offered alongside the 11.25" curve in some Bachmann catalogue printings. radius 11.4 in × 25.4 = 289.56 mm; arc length = 2π × 289.56 × (22.5 / 360) = 113.701 mm. The 11.4" radius is documented in dealer listings (Walthers / Trainz) but the SKU is not consistently published on Bachmann's site, so it is left null. The 11.25" / 11.4" near-duplication should be reconciled at live-verify time — these may be the same physical section described two ways across catalogue editions.

pieces.label: Manual turnout, left
pieces.notes: Bachmann does not publish a frog-number for its N E-Z Track turnout; it is generally treated as a starter-set-grade ‘standard’ turnout. Overall length and divergence are not published on the manufacturer page; left null per ‘empty is honest’.

pieces.label: Manual turnout, right
pieces.notes: Right-hand mirror of the left manual turnout. Same caveats.

pieces.label: Remote turnout, left
pieces.notes: Powered version of the left manual turnout. Geometry assumed identical.

pieces.label: Remote turnout, right
pieces.notes: Powered version of the right manual turnout.

pieces.label: 5" terminal rerailer with wires
pieces.notes: Drop-in replacement for a 5" N straight, pre-wired as the layout's power feed. Same 127.0 mm length as the plain 5" straight.

pieces.label: Hayes bumper / end-of-track stop
pieces.notes: Plug-on bumper; clips into the end of any E-Z Track N section without contributing measurable centerline length, so length_mm is null.

data_quality_note: Generated 2026-05-05 by an agent without working WebFetch/WebSearch access. Geometry math (length_mm = in*25.4; curve length = 2*pi*r*deg/360) is hand-computed and high-confidence. Product codes (SKUs) and source_url values are derived from training-data recall and were NOT live-verified. source_verified_at is null on every piece until a session with web access re-checks the catalog.
